Sandbox_SurvivalPlannerList_ArrivalRadiu: An active plan with arrival auto-completion enabled is completed when the character comes within this many tiles of its map target. The character must be on the same floor and carry a writing tool and an eraser.
Sandbox_SurvivalPlannerList_InventorySca: How often Survival Planner scans the character's inventory and carried bags for planners, tools, and tracked item quantities. Lower values react faster but use more CPU.
Sandbox_SurvivalPlannerList_NavigationRe: How often Survival Planner adds, removes, or updates navigation targets and widgets. Arrow movement and rotation remain smooth between refreshes.
